description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single ranged attacks (0.60 each), causes [DEF, RES and MND -70% (8s)], grants [Attach Fire 3 with Stacking], [Synchro Mode], [Damage Cap +10000], [Intrinsic Pirate Mode] and [Need for Speed Follow-Up] to the user

description.name: Attach Fire 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands

description.name: Intrinsic Pirate Mode
description.text: Grants [Dualcast Fire 1]/[Triplecast Fire 1]/[Quadracast Fire 1]/[Pentacast Fire 1], [Fire Ability +10% Boost 1]/[Fire Ability +15% Boost 1]/[Fire Ability +20% Boost 1]/[Fire Ability +30% Boost 1] and -/-/[100% Critical 1]/[100% Critical 1] to the character after using Liberating Heat if the character has Reward level 1/2/3/4, sets Reward level to 0 after using a Fire abilty

description.name: Need for Speed Follow-Up
description.text: Casts Need for Speed after using Liberating Heat
